2609.26028.title: REVE: Efficient Hallucination Correction for Large Audio-Language Models via Reused Encoder States
2609.26028.paper_summary: Large audio-language models may mention acoustic events that are absent from the input. A separate audio event detector can verify these mentions, but doing so requires a second audio encoder and a separate forward pass. We propose Reused Encoder States for Verifying Events (REVE), a lightweight method that uses states already computed by the target model. One readout summarizes class scores across audio frames, while another uses pooled states from four consecutive frame intervals. Class-aware score fusion combines their outputs to verify generated event mentions without encoding the audio again. On AudioSet, REVE removes 92.9% of label-unsupported mentions under a faithful-mention recall constraint. With fewer added parameters and no second audio-encoding pass, REVE achieves a reduction comparable to those of CED-Tiny and CED-Base. Its complete verification latency is about 1/18 of the CED-Base path. Results on controlled DESED mixtures and different target-model architectures further confirm the effectiveness of encoder-state reuse.
2609.26028.paper_summary_zh: 大型音頻語言模型可能會提到輸入中缺失的聲音事件。單獨的音頻事件檢測器可以驗證這些提及，但這樣做需要第二個音頻編碼器和單獨的前向傳遞。我們提出了重用編碼器狀態以驗證事件（REVE），這是一種輕量級的方法，利用目標模型已經計算出的狀態。一個讀出總結了跨音頻幀的類別分數，而另一個則使用來自四個連續幀間隔的池化狀態。類別感知的分數融合將它們的輸出結合起來，以在不再次編碼音頻的情況下驗證生成的事件提及。在AudioSet上，REVE在忠實提及召回約束下移除了92.9%的標籤不支持的提及。REVE增加的參數較少，且不需要第二次音頻編碼傳遞，其減少量與CED-Tiny和CED-Base相當。其完整的驗證延遲約為CED-Base路徑的1/18。對受控的DESED混合物和不同目標模型架構的結果進一步確認了編碼器狀態重用的有效性。
